For Telegram, paste \u003cstrong\u003eTelegram Bot Token\u003c/strong\u003e and \u003cstrong\u003eAllowed Telegram User ID\u003c/strong\u003e.\u003c/li\u003e\n\u003cli\u003eSet \u003cstrong\u003eAllowed Directory\u003c/strong\u003e to an absolute path on the machine running the proxy—the workspace root the bot may use.\u003c/li\u003e\n\u003cli\u003eClick \u003cstrong\u003eValidate\u003c/strong\u003e, then \u003cstrong\u003eApply\u003c/strong\u003e. \u003ccode\u003eMODEL_OPUS\u003c/code\u003e, \u003ccode\u003eMODEL_SONNET\u003c/code\u003e, \u003ccode\u003eMODEL_HAIKU\u003c/code\u003e, or \u003ccode\u003eMODEL\u003c/code\u003e.\u003c/li\u003e\n\u003cli\u003eNIM, OpenCode Zen, and OpenCode Go use OpenAI chat streaming translated into Anthropic SSE.\u003c/li\u003e\n\u003cli\u003eWafer, URLs).\u003c/li\u003e\n\u003cli\u003eThe proxy normalizes thinking blocks, tool calls, token usage metadata, and provider errors into the shape Claude Code expects.\u003c/li\u003e\n\u003cli\u003eRequest optimizations answer trivial Claude Code probes locally to save latency and quota.\u003c/li\u003e\n\u003c/ul\u003e\n\u003cdiv class=\"markdown-heading\" <ul dir="auto">
<li>Drop-in proxy for Claude Code's Anthropic API calls.</li>
<li>17 provider backends: NVIDIA NIM, OpenRouter, Google AI Studio (Gemini), DeepSeek, Mistral La Plateforme, Mistral Codestral, OpenCode Zen, OpenCode Go, Wafer, Kimi, Cerebras Inference, Groq, Fireworks AI, Z.ai, LM Studio, llama.cpp, and Ollama.</li>
<li>Per-model routing: send Opus, Sonnet, Haiku, and fallback traffic to different providers.</li>
<li>Native Claude Code <code>/model</code> picker support through the proxy's <code>/v1/models</code> endpoint (Claude Code must opt in to Gateway model discovery; see <a href="#model-picker">Model Picker</a>).</li>
<li>Streaming, tool use, reasoning/thinking block handling, and local request optimizations.</li>
<li>Optional Discord or Telegram bot wrapper for remote coding sessions.</li>
<li>Optional Usage through the VSCode extension.</li>
<li>Optional voice-note transcription through local Whisper or NVIDIA NIM.</li>
<li>Local <strong>Admin UI</strong> at <code>/admin</code> to edit supported proxy settings, validate changes, and check providers (loopback access only).</li>
</ul>

<p dir="auto">In the Admin UI, set <code>CEREBRAS_API_KEY</code>, then route with <code>MODEL</code> such as <code>cerebras/llama3.1-8b</code> or <code>cerebras/gpt-oss-120b</code> (ids from <a href="https://inference-docs.cerebras.ai/api-reference/models/list-models" rel="nofollow">List models</a>).</p>
<p dir="auto">Cerebras exposes an OpenAI-compatible API at <code>https://api.cerebras.ai/v1</code> (<a href="https://inference-docs.cerebras.ai/resources/openai" rel="nofollow">OpenAI compatibility</a>). Non-standard request fields should go in <code>extra_body</code> when using the OpenAI client; see the same page. For reasoning models and parameters, see <a href="https://inference-docs.cerebras.ai/capabilities/reasoning" rel="nofollow">Reasoning</a>. This proxy follows other OpenAI-compat adapters for thinking via <code>reasoning_content</code> when Claude-style thinking is enabled.</p>

<p dir="auto">In the Admin UI, paste it into <code>GROQ_API_KEY</code>, then set <code>MODEL</code> to a Groq OpenAI-compat model slug such as <code>groq/llama-3.3-70b-versatile</code>.</p>
<p dir="auto">Groq routes through <code>https://api.groq.com/openai/v1</code> (<a href="https://console.groq.com/docs/openai" rel="nofollow">OpenAI-compatible Chat Completions</a>). Some request fields yield HTTP 400; this adapter strips known-unsupported shapes (documented in Groq's compatibility notes).</p>

This release mirrors other OpenAI-compat adapters for thinking via <code>reasoning_content</code> deltas when Claude-style thinking is enabled; you can tune advanced parameters through request <code>extra_body</code> when needed.</p>
<p dir="auto">Browse models at <a href="https://console.groq.com/docs/models" rel="nofollow">console.groq.com/docs/models</a>.</p>

<p dir="auto">Keep <code>fcc-server</code> running while you work. The Admin UI manages proxy config, restarts the server when runtime settings change, and <code>fcc-claude</code> reads the current Admin UI-managed port and auth token every time it starts. It also sets <code>CLAUDE_CODE_AUTO_COMPACT_WINDOW</code> to <code>190000</code> for auto-compaction.</p>

Discord And Telegram Bots" href="#1-discord-and-telegram-bots"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<p dir="auto">The bot wrapper runs Claude Code sessions remotely, streams progress, supports reply-based conversation branches, and can stop or clear tasks.</p>
<p dir="auto"><strong>Discord</strong></p>
<ol dir="auto">
<li>Create the bot in the <a href="https://discord.com/developers/applications" rel="nofollow">Discord Developer Portal</a>.</li>
<li>Enable <strong>Message Content Intent</strong>.</li>
<li>Invite the bot with read, send, and message history permissions.</li>
<li>Copy the bot token and the numeric channel ID (or IDs) where the bot should respond.</li>
</ol>
<p dir="auto"><strong>Telegram</strong></p>
<ol dir="auto">
<li>Create a bot with <a href="https://t.me/BotFather" rel="nofollow">@BotFather</a> and copy the bot token.</li>
<li>Get your numeric user ID from <a href="https://t.me/userinfobot" rel="nofollow">@userinfobot</a> so only you can use the bot.</li>
</ol>
<p dir="auto"><strong>Configure in the Admin UI</strong></p>
<ol dir="auto">
<li>With <code>fcc-server</code> running, open the <strong>Admin UI</strong> URL from the terminal output.</li>
<li>In the sidebar, choose <strong>Messaging</strong>.</li>
<li>Set <strong>Messaging Platform</strong> to <strong>discord</strong> or <strong>telegram</strong>.</li>
<li>For Discord, paste <strong>Discord Bot Token</strong> and <strong>Allowed Discord Channels</strong>. For Telegram, paste <strong>Telegram Bot Token</strong> and <strong>Allowed Telegram User ID</strong>.</li>
<li>Set <strong>Allowed Directory</strong> to an absolute path on the machine running the proxy—the workspace root the bot may use.</li>
<li>Click <strong>Validate</strong>, then <strong>Apply</strong>. Restart the server if the UI says one is required.</li>
</ol>
<div align="center" dir="auto">
  <a target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" href="/Alishahryar1/free-claude-code/blob/main/assets/admin-messaging.png"><img src="/Alishahryar1/free-claude-code/raw/main/assets/admin-messaging.png" alt="Admin UI Messaging view with bot and voice settings" width="700" style="max-width: 100%;"></a>
</div>
<p align="center" dir="auto"><em>Admin UI → Messaging (platform, bots, and Voice)</em></p>
<p dir="auto"><strong>Useful commands</strong></p>
<ul dir="auto">
<li><code>/stop</code> cancels a task; reply to a task message to stop only that branch.</li>
<li><code>/clear</code> resets sessions; reply to clear one branch.</li>
<li><code>/stats</code> shows session state.</li>
</ul>

<p dir="auto">Restart <code>fcc-server</code> after reinstalling.</p>
<p dir="auto">In the <strong>Admin UI</strong>, open <strong>Messaging</strong> and scroll to <strong>Voice</strong>. Turn on <strong>Voice Notes</strong>, choose <strong>Whisper Device</strong> (<code>cpu</code>, <code>cuda</code>, or <code>nvidia_nim</code>), set <strong>Whisper Model</strong>, and enter <strong>Hugging Face Token</strong> when your setup needs it. For <strong>nvidia_nim</strong> transcription, install the <code>voice</code> extra and set <strong>NVIDIA NIM API Key</strong> on the <strong>Providers</strong> view. The screenshot above shows the <strong>Voice</strong> block in the same view.</p>

<p dir="auto">Important pieces:</p>
<ul dir="auto">
<li>FastAPI exposes Anthropic-compatible routes such as <code>/v1/messages</code>, <code>/v1/messages/count_tokens</code>, and <code>/v1/models</code>.</li>
<li>Model routing resolves the Claude model name to <code>MODEL_OPUS</code>, <code>MODEL_SONNET</code>, <code>MODEL_HAIKU</code>, or <code>MODEL</code>.</li>
<li>NIM, OpenCode Zen, and OpenCode Go use OpenAI chat streaming translated into Anthropic SSE.</li>
<li>Wafer, OpenRouter, DeepSeek, Kimi, Fireworks AI, Z.ai, LM Studio, llama.cpp, and Ollama use Anthropic Messages style transports where applicable (with provider-specific quirks and model-list URLs).</li>
<li>The proxy normalizes thinking blocks, tool calls, token usage metadata, and provider errors into the shape Claude Code expects.</li>
<li>Request optimizations answer trivial Claude Code probes locally to save latency and quota.</li>
</ul>

<p dir="auto"><code>pyproject.toml</code> installs:</p>
<ul dir="auto">
<li><code>fcc-server</code>: starts the proxy with configured host and port.</li>
<li><code>fcc-init</code>: optional advanced scaffold for <code>~/.fcc/.env</code>; prefer the <strong>Admin UI</strong> for normal configuration.</li>
<li><code>fcc-claude</code>: launches Claude Code with the configured local proxy URL, auth token, model discovery flag, and a 190k <code>CLAUDE_CODE_AUTO_COMPACT_WINDOW</code> for auto-compaction.</li>
<li><code>free-claude-code</code>: compatibility alias for <code>fcc-server</code>.</li>
</ul>
<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h3 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">5. Extending</h3><a id="user-content-5-extending" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: 5. Extending" href="#5-extending"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<ul dir="auto">
<li>Add OpenAI-compatible providers by extending <code>OpenAIChatTransport</code>.</li>
<li>Add Anthropic Messages providers by extending <code>AnthropicMessagesTransport</code>.</li>
<li>Register provider metadata in <code>config.provider_catalog</code> and factory wiring in <code>providers.registry</code>.</li>
<li>Add messaging platforms by implementing the <code>MessagingPlatform</code> interface in <code>messaging/</code>.</li>
</ul>
<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h2 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">Contributing</h2><a id="user-content-contributing" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: Contributing" href="#contributing"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<ul dir="auto">
<li><a href="/Alishahryar1/free-claude-code/blob/main/.env.example"><code>.env.example</code></a> lists env key names as a read-only reference for contributors; use the <strong>Admin UI</strong> to change managed proxy settings.</li>
<li>Report bugs and feature requests in <a href="https://github.com/Alishahryar1/free-claude-code/issues">Issues</a>. For bug always include all model mapping, current model when issue occured and the issue string</li>
<li>Keep changes small and covered by focused tests.</li>
<li>Do not open Docker integration PRs.</li>
<li>Do not open README change PRs just open an issue for it.</li>
<li>Run the full check sequence before opening a pull request.</li>
<li>The syntax <code>except X, Y</code> is brought back in python 3.14 final version (not in 3.14 alpha). Keep in mind before opening PRs.</li>
</ul>
